productModel.goalModel: Ascent centers one meaningful goal. That goal can include several supporting habits, while the app keeps one next step prominent.
productModel.summary: An iPhone habit system that combines a 70-day goal progression, visible next steps, two-minute fallback actions, reflection, and optional Screen Time friction before selected distracting apps.
productModel.screenTime: Screen Time access is optional. The goal plan, daily actions, two-minute fallback, widgets, and reflection work without app-blocking features.
productModel.ai: AI-assisted features can generate plan content, smaller fallback actions, and in-app coaching. Availability and usage limits vary by plan.
